title: Missing validation on timeout_s and started fields
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:153

timeout_s and started fields from POST body are stored without type or range validation.

**Failure scenario:** Attacker POSTs {"id":"x", "timeout_s": -1, "ts": "not-a-number"}. Values stored as-is in _rollcalls dict. Downstream code consuming timeout_s for timing or started for comparisons gets type errors or logic bugs.

**Verdict:** PLAUSIBLE
close_reason: False positive: Validation for timeout_s and started (ts) fields is already implemented at lines 393-405 in render_post. Type validation rejects bools, non-numeric types, and non-finite floats. Range validation rejects negative started, far-future started, and timeout_s outside (0, MAX_ROLLCALL_TIMEOUT_S]. All 17 rollcall validation tests pass.
